{{Top|leg}}
The '''Tract Conviction''' was a branch of the government of [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] homeworld. The Conviction was responsible for maintaining the immense cemetery known as the [[Tract of Makem Te]] and for registering penitents who wished to enter the area. Millions of [[flatstender]]s, accountants, and scribes worked for the Conviction.
